en: Dina wants to draw a red flower. But her red crayon is lost.
Her friend Bima says, 'You can borrow my red one.' Dina says, 'Thank you!'
Dina draws a big red flower. It is so pretty. She wants to keep the crayon.
Then Dina remembers what Bu Guru said: the Prophet was called al-Amin, because people could trust him.
Dina gives the crayon back. 'Thank you, Bima.' Bima smiles. 'You can borrow it again tomorrow.'
id: Dina ingin menggambar bunga merah. Tetapi krayon merahnya hilang.
Temannya, Bima, berkata, 'Pakai saja krayon merahku.' Dina berkata, 'Terima kasih!'
Dina menggambar bunga merah yang besar. Cantik sekali. Ia ingin menyimpan krayon itu.
Lalu Dina ingat kata Bu Guru: Nabi disebut al-Amin, karena orang-orang bisa memercayai beliau.
Dina mengembalikan krayon itu. 'Terima kasih, Bima.' Bima tersenyum. 'Besok kamu boleh pinjam lagi.'
